decisions.reason: Cloud transactional email is a growth area for an enterprise messaging provider, and it was featured on the home page, so it is likely a strategic product.
Managed capture services have their own page and a documented customer reference, and they fit the ongoing digitization of document workflows.
Email-to-fax conversion is tied to the firm's established fax business, which German enterprises and healthcare still rely on.
This feature costs little to maintain within the fax infrastructure, though it could eventually be absorbed into the core fax offering rather than listed separately.
Rising ransomware and phishing threats make sandboxing a key part of the email security portfolio, especially after the multi-engine scanning product was consolidated.
